asset: Single switch/contact cue for existing original request14 only
approval: Nell selected New switch only. Original radio retained.

rights.author: Kenney interface sound plus project-authored mechanical synthesis
rights.scope: Designed interface contact, not a tank field recording. No game-original audio, paid recording, voice or music.

source.used_interval: Entire short click_002.ogg decoded to 558 mono frames at 48000 Hz. One contact, no repeat.

authored_inputs.legacy_recipe: effect(switch, 0.12, 1993), existing pcm() attack/tail fade and int16 conversion. Reconstructed exactly in the private replay proof; no original game audio read.
authored_inputs.noise: NumPy default_rng PCG64 seed 202610261114. Consume 31200 standard-normal values for the preceding radio experiment, then draw 5760 for the switch. No radio audio enters the switch.

design_recipe: Band-limit decoded CC0 contact 320 to 6500 Hz, second-order SciPy Butterworth SOS; normalize its absolute peak.
Band-limit switch noise 600 to 5600 Hz, normalize its standard deviation. Envelope exp(-t*100)*min(1,t/0.001).
Body: (0.10*sin(2*pi*790*t)+0.055*sin(2*pi*1310*t))*envelope. Texture: 0.055*noise*envelope. Contact: normalized input*0.095, aligned t=0, first 48 samples ramped i/48.
Sum legacy PCM*0.30, body, texture and contact. Subtract mean, apply final 256-frame fade i=255..0 divided by256; set sample0 to zero.
Match whole-event RMS to legacy PCM; apply recorded loudness refinement gain 1.2999999999999972 dB; round x*32768 to little-endian int16.
build: tools/build_audio.py hash-checks and copies the approved master unchanged using only the standard library. The master is the reproducible build input; no ignored paths, synthesis dependencies or network access are required.
